connor_cust: Hey, running into 401 when opening websocket upgrade to streams endpoint. Works over REST with same key.

alex_support: Sorry to hear that — can you paste the exact wss URL (redact key) and a short repro? Also browser vs server?

connor_cust: Using browser (Chrome) and server (node). Example: wss://api.redwood.ai/v1/streams?api_key=sk_live_A1B2C3/DEF+G==
Browser upgrade fails with 401 and server side (wscat) shows Upgrade response 401 invalid_api_key.
I compared responses: curl to https://api.redwood.ai/v1/completions -H "Authorization: Bearer sk_live_A1B2C3/DEF+G==" works fine.

sara_engineer: Interesting — looks like your key contains a "/" and a "+". Can you check whether the key is being URL-encoded on the client? Browsers will send the raw query; some proxies normalize or split on "/" if not encoded.

connor_cust: I logged the request at our edge (using tcpdump) and indeed the query param arrives truncated at the first "/". Example seen in raw GET: GET /v1/streams?api_key=sk_live_A1B2C3 HTTP/1.1

alex_support: That points to a proxy or CDN rewriting the URL. Which CDN/edge are you behind?

connor_cust: We're on Fastly in front of our app (VCL modification). We also have a Cloudflare worker on another route.

sara_engineer: Repro steps I used: 
- wscat -c "wss://api.redwood.ai/v1/streams?api_key=sk_live_A1B2C3/DEF+G=="
- tcpdump on client shows query param as sent, but server logs show truncated token.

infra_ops: We saw similar behavior earlier where Fastly VCL rule normalized the URL and dropped parts after an unescaped slash in query args. Workarounds:
- Encode the key: encodeURIComponent('sk_live_A1B2C3/DEF+G==') -> sk_live_A1B2C3%2FDEF%2BG%3D%3D
- Move the key into the websocket subprotocol or send it in the Upgrade headers for non-browser clients.

connor_cust: Encoding fixed it for us (encodeURIComponent) — thx. But can you make server accept raw unencoded keys for compatibility?

sara_engineer: Filed infra ticket to make server decode query params more robustly and treat unescaped "/" in query param as part of value. For browsers we still recommend URL-encoding keys. Filed: INF-2026-114 : will add fallback for websocket upgrade parsing.

deploy-bot: Deployment scheduled: INF-2026-114 -> staged on canary at 2026-03-20 03:00 UTC

connor_cust: Verified on staging canary — raw key no longer truncated. Production deploy rolled: :rocket: Thanks!

alex_support: Glad it's resolved. Marking thread resolved. Please reopen if you see another 401.
